messages:
Rae: Quick poll for swag planning: which mascot should represent our small/open models for the conference stickers? Drop the emoji or reply with your pick.
Options:
• :octopus: Kraken
• :compass: Scout
• :wrench: Tinker
• :comet: Comet

Ben: :octopus: Kraken — big vibes, tiny model irony.

Noor: :compass: Scout! Feels friendly and explorer-y.

Mateo: :comet: Comet for the motion/latency theme.

Claire: :wrench: Tinker because our infra team will love it.

Rae: also accepting write-ins. tag me if you have a design idea.

design-bot: Note added: prefer vector-friendly shapes for stickers.

Ben: +1 on vector-friendly. Kraken might be complicated at small sizes.

Noor: Scout seems simplest and probably easiest to silhouette.

poll-bot: Poll closed (24m). Results: Kraken 1, Scout 2, Tinker 1, Comet 1, Write-ins 0. Scout wins :tada:

Rae: Nice! I'll loop in design with "Scout" as the chosen mascot and share concepts tomorrow. Thanks all for the speedy votes :sparkles:
